title: Fake KYC update / bank account block (synthetic)

turns.text: Good afternoon sir, I am calling from Greenfield Cooperative Bank KYC branch. Listen carefully, your account is getting blocked today itself because KYC is pending.
Arey sir, your pension will stop and ATM card will be deactivated immediately! We have to complete the update in next ten minutes only, do fast!
To update KYC, install our official support app first. Download from https://kyc-update.example/greenfield-support.apk and open it now itself.
Okay sir, open your phone UPI app and keep it ready for verification payment na.
App is not opening ah? Then pay one rupee token verification to our KYC desk UPI ID kyc.desk@okaxis.
Yes, kyc.desk@okaxis, K Y C dot desk at okaxis. Do it fast, send one rupee now!
Arey sir, hurry up na! System is cutting off and locking your account!
UPI is failing because server restriction is there. Transfer the amount to the bank holding account directly.
Note down: Account number three three four four five five six six seven seven eight eight, IFSC Y E S B zero zero zero seven seven one.
Repeat back: 3344 5566 7788, YESB0000771. If any issue is there, call our helpline on eight eight double zero one two three four five six.
Arey sir, why you are doing so slow? Quick quick, account is getting blocked right now!
